paite: Huchi a hiai thilte hih khit ahih lai in, ka kiang ah vaihawmtute ahong pai nai ua, "Israel mite leh siampute leh Levi mite, gamte a mite a kipan amau leh amau akikoihtuam kei ua, amaute kihhuainate, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Periz mi, Jebus mi, Ammon mi, Moab mi, Aigupta mi leh Amor mite, dungzui in a-om uhi.
heading: Ezra In Judah Hiloute Toh Kitenpolhna Thu Aza

paite: Amau a ding leh atapate uh a ding in atanute uh ala ua; huchi in chi siangthou gamte mite toh amau leh amau akihelkhawmta hi: ahi, hiai tatlekna ah vaihawmtute khut leh vaihawmte amakai lianpente ahi uhi," achi hi.
Huchi a hiai thil ka zak in, ka puansilh leh ka puanak ka botkek a, ka lu a sam leh ka khamul ka botkhia a, lamdang sa in ka tusuk hi.
Huai lai in saltanna a amaute tatlekna ziak a, Israel' Pathian thute ziak a lau a ling michih ka kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua; nitaklam kithoih hun masiah lamdang sa in ka tu hi.
Nitaklam kithoih hun lai in ka tunggikna a pan ka thou a, ka puansilh leh ka puanak bohkeksa toh; ka khukdin a, TOUPA ka Pathian lam ah ka khutte ka zakkhia a;
"Aw ka Pathian, na kiang a daktou ding in ka zum in ka zakta hi, ka Pathian: ka thulimlouhnate uh ka lutunglam uah apung deuhdeuh a, ka mohna un vante asunta hi.

Ka pipute uh dam lai hun a kipan tuni pha in nakpi in ka mohta ua; huchi in ka thulimlouhnate uh ziak in kou, ka kumpipate uh leh ka siampute uh, gamte kumpipate khut ah, namsau ah, saltanna ah, lohna ah leh zahlakna ah, hiai ni bang in piakkhiak in ka omta uhi.

Huan tu in sawt lou sung a ding in TOUPA ka Pathian ua kipan in hehpihna hong lang a, suakta ding a om lai dia nutsiat ding in leh amun siangthou a omkipna hon pe ding in, huchi a ka Pathian un ka mitte uh ahon sukvaksak a, ka tanna ua halhna neukha ahon piaktheihna ding in.

Sikha lah ka hi ngal ua; huchipi in leng sikha ka hihna uah ka Pathian un ahon mangngilh kei a, himahleh Persia kumpipate mitmuh in zahngaihna ahon pia a, halhna hon pe ding, ka Pathian uh inn dingsak ding leh huai a siatna bawlpha ding leh Judah leh Jerusalem a kulhbaang hon pe ding in.
"Tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai zoh in bang ka chita ding ua? Na thupiakte lah ka lehngatsanta ngal ua,
Na sikha zawlneite zang in thu na hon pia a: 'Luah ding a na paina uh, huai gam, gamte a mite nitna ziak a gam nin ahi. Akihhuainate un gam tawp khat lam a kipan khat lam tawp tan ahihdimna ziak in.

Huaiziak in na tanute uh atapate uh kiang ah pe kei unla, atanute uh leng na tapate uh a ding in la sam kei un, amuanna uhiam ahauhsakna uhiam leng tangtawn in zong sam kei un: huchi a na hat ua, gam a ahoih na nek ua, tangtawn a na tate uh a ding a gouluah dia na nutsiat theihna ding un.'

Huchi a ka gamtat giloute uh ziak leh ka mohna thupi mahmah ziak ua, ka tung ua hong tung tengteng zoh in, nang ka Pathian un ka thulimlouhnate uh gunzah sang a hon gawt tawmzaw a, akhosuaksun om lai na hon piak mu in.
Na thupiakte bohse nawn in, kihhuaite hih mite toh kituak in ka om ding uam? Akhosuak ding hiam, suakta ding himhim leng om lou khop a na bawlgawp matan ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia?

Aw TOUPA Israel' Pathian, nang na diktat a; hiai ni bang a akhosuak omlaite na hon nutsiat ziak in. Ngai in, ka mohna un na ma ah ka om uhi;' hiai ziak in lah kuamah na ma ah adingh thei kei ding uhi."
